measurementSemantics.firstSubmissionMs: CPU wall time of the actual mode-triggered viewport frame; firstFrame.completedFrameWallMs also includes mode/rAF scheduling and completion observation.
measurementSemantics.cpuSubmissionMedianMs: Legacy field: complete viewport render CPU wall time, not just GL submission.
measurementSemantics.totalRenderMedianMs: Observed completed-frame wall time including camera/document mutation for moving/edit workloads; excludes next-rAF wait and desktop presentation.
measurementSemantics.preparationMs: Legacy GPU pre-GL CPU total; detailed cache lookup and geometry preparation are separate.
measurementSemantics.submissionMs: Legacy GPU GL CPU total including initialization/upload/draw; detailed stages are separate.
measurementSemantics.documentDelta: Partial entity preparation is distinct from full-scene rebuilds; uploadKind separately records full, subrange or no successful-frame issuance. Edit memo statistics refer to bounded owned geometry history.
measurementSemantics.gpuAttempt: Requested-GPU attempt CPU stages and requested uploads, including refused attempts; null means unavailable. actualRenderer labels the completed frame. Canvas fallback wall time includes the refused attempt and full Canvas rendering/readback.

gpuPreference.scope: Private launched app only; requested preference is not proof of active hardware.

limitations: Single Windows machine or CI runner; OS caches not purged.
Cold frames reset renderer resources and the Canvas scene cache, not process/driver caches; drawing fixture loading precedes measurement.
Mode-triggered first-frame latency includes animation-frame scheduling; frame CPU and completion waits are also reported separately.
Drawing pointer input is disabled during comparisons so hover changes cannot alter the measured scene; hover invalidation is covered by regression tests.
GPU fence wall waits include driver/CPU scheduling and exclude final desktop presentation.
Canvas readback completion is not a pure GPU timer.
GPU memory is uploaded buffer bytes only; JS heap is approximate and shared with the whole application.

Edit/undo measures one immutable visible line with fixed style/count/order; other edits may still require full preparation, upload or complete-view Canvas fallback. Geometry and subrange-upload stages are CPU issuance, with successful-frame fence wall completion reported separately.

exportProvenance.format: Losslessly compact JSON for benchmark reports; native reports remain indented.
